input.free_text_description: The system operates in the banking, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include account, fund transfer, security config. Core business data revolves around FundTransfer, Sequence, Transaction, TransactionStatus.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to manage my account settings, so that my preferences and personal data stay under my control.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage fund transfer operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage security config operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
